description: Auto-re-login flow: when a web UI session expires mid-run, present an inline re-authentication overlay that preserves the current page state (run view, step detail) so the user can re-authenticate and resume watching without losing context. Currently showLoginForm() wipes the DOM and forces a full reload on success.
steps: In src/web/public/app.js, create a new function showReauthOverlay() that renders a modal/overlay login form ON TOP of the existing content (not replacing it). The overlay should have a semi-transparent backdrop, a centered card with token input and submit button, and text explaining the session expired. On successful POST /api/auth, dismiss the overlay and resume normal operation without reload - just call loadSessionThenCatalog() or similar to refresh auth state in-place.

Modify the apiAuth() function: instead of calling showLoginForm() on 401, call showReauthOverlay() which preserves the current view. The old showLoginForm() remains for the initial login (no prior state to preserve).

Handle the EventSource edge case: when openStream() detects auth failure on its pre-flight check, show the reauth overlay. After successful re-auth, retry the stream connection automatically. Add a retry mechanism: after the overlay dismisses, if S.runId is set and S.es is null, re-open the stream.

Add a session heartbeat: periodically (every 60s) ping GET /api/session. If it returns 401, show the reauth overlay proactively BEFORE the user hits a 401 on a real action. This prevents the jarring experience of clicking Approve and getting bounced.
Handle the case where multiple 401s fire simultaneously (parallel API calls): the overlay should only show once. Use a flag (S.reauthVisible) to prevent duplicate overlays.

On the server side (src/web/server.ts), ensure POST /api/auth response includes the session capability and readOnly status (already does), and add a response field 'sessionTtlMs' so the client knows the session lifetime for smarter heartbeat scheduling.
Add CSS styles for the reauth overlay in src/web/public/app.css - backdrop blur, centered card, focus management (trap focus inside the overlay while visible).
acceptance_criteria: When a session expires mid-run, an overlay appears on top of the current view - the run pipeline, step cards, and detail drawer remain visible behind it
After entering a valid token in the overlay, the overlay dismisses and the user continues viewing their run without page reload or state loss
If an EventSource stream was active, it automatically reconnects after re-auth
Multiple simultaneous 401 responses show only one overlay
The session heartbeat catches expiry before user interaction triggers a 401
All existing tests pass unchanged, typecheck passes, lint passes
